mandatory_relays.message: GTEx whole blood is drawn from femoral/subclavian veins and measured by bulk RNA-seq (755 samples, median TPM). Report this as 'GTEx whole-blood RNA-seq expression', not as 'peripheral blood expression'. It is a partial proxy, not an equivalent measurement.

threshold_provenance: GTEx Portal (gtexportal.org), dataset gtex_v8. GTEx publishes median TPM from bulk RNA-seq but defines no expression-level cutoffs. No peer-reviewed source establishes universal TPM thresholds for classifying GTEx whole-blood expression. The Human Protein Atlas (HPA) uses nTPM with its own cutoffs (nTPM >= 1 for 'detected'), but nTPM and TPM are not directly comparable — different normalization, different tissue sets, different pipelines. All values are UNRESOLVED.
